class.name: E3DModelSmokeSourceDefinition
class.brief_description: Describes a particle emitter of an E3D model
class.description: An emitter is a transform submodel named [code]smokesource_<template>[/code]. The whole submodel name is also the name of the parameter file the emitter uses, which the original reads from the game's [code]data/[/code] directory. See https://wiki.eu07.pl/index.php/Emiter_dymu

members.member: Node path to the submodel the particles are emitted from.
Name of the parameter template, i.e. the submodel name in lower case.
